vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate defaults this to null, so security-fix PRs would skip the wait.

packageRules.description: Renovate releases several times a day; bump the validator weekly.
mise names linters by package path; the Go proxy only knows the module, and without it there's no release time for minimumReleaseAge.
Renovate skips indirect Go deps by default, which left vulnerable ones (sw-update's brotli and compress via sevenzip) unbumped.
Bump go.mod's go line with mise.toml's Go, in one PR; by default Renovate leaves the go line alone.
